description: Component Registry & Index for Remotion Visual Core V4 (Spatial 3D & HUD Architecture)

components.name: Stage3DWrapper
components.description: Remotion ThreeCanvas wrapper with cinematic lighting, ambient Sparkles particles, postprocessing Bloom, and deterministic camera modes (orbit, dolly-in, fly-through, breathing) driven by useCurrentFrame().

components.name: ColonHologram3D
components.description: Procedural 3D colonic intestine hologram using TubeGeometry along a CatmullRomCurve3 with physical holographic glass, outer wireframe scan grid, and a pulsing MeshDistortMaterial polyp warning sphere at the rectum.

props.highlightPolyp: boolean (whether polyp pulses red warning, default true)

components.name: EndoscopySimulation3D
components.description: Procedural 3D endoscopic closeup inside the intestinal mucosa: gut wall lining, distorting polyp, advancing metallic endoscope probe, and glowing 3D surgical laser beam with polyp detachment lifting animation.

props.cutProgress: number (0: intact, 0.25-0.75: laser firing, 0.5-1.0: polyp detachment & suction)

components.name: BioShield3D
components.description: Dual-layer icosahedron holographic shield with counter-rotating inner glass core and outer wireframe cage plus equatorial energy ring for screening and healthcare protection scenes.

components.name: DNAStrand3D
components.description: Parametric double-helix DNA strand with nucleotide node spheres and glowing base-pair rungs rotating continuously in 3D space.

components.name: BloodCellStream3D
components.description: 3D streaming flow of biconcave red blood cells (erythrocytes) tumbling realistically along the vascular axis in 3D space.

components.name: Candlestick3DChart
components.description: 3D Japanese Candlestick chart featuring dimensional box bodies, cylinder wicks, bullish/bearish color mapping, staggered growth springs, and reference grid floor.

props.data: Array<{ open: number; close: number; high: number; low: number; label?: string }>

components.name: BarRace3DTowers
components.description: 3D monolithic towers racing height in isometric perspective, featuring physical metallic materials, high-emission summit caps, and pedestal base slab.

props.items: Array<{ label: string; value: number; color?: string }>

components.name: WealthVaultShield3D
components.description: Central faceted diamond core encased in dual gold gimbal rings and satellite energy orbs representing capital preservation, wealth management, and insurance.

components.name: SpatialHUDCard
components.description: 2.5D Spatial Glass HUD Card container combining 3D perspective, floating physics, multi-layer glassmorphism, sci-fi corner brackets [ ], and animated laser sweep scanline.

components.name: HeroMetricCard
components.description: Archetype 1: Oversized hero KPI metric (e.g. 96px number + 36px unit) with category badge, description, footnote, and automatic SpatialHUDCard 3D tilt & laser effects.

components.name: ComparisonCard
components.description: Archetype 2: Side-by-side comparison card (left column vs right column) with positive/negative semantic badges and bullet points in a unified SpatialHUDCard 3D envelope.

props.left: { title: string; badge: string; points: string[]; isNegative?: boolean }
props.right: { title: string; badge: string; points: string[]; isPositive?: boolean }

components.name: FeatureGridCard
components.description: Archetype 3: 3-column feature and benefit grid card with circular glowing icon badges, bold headings, and descriptions inside a SpatialHUDCard 3D wrapper.

props.items: Array<{ icon: string; title: string; desc: string }>

components.name: StepFlowCard
components.description: Archetype 4: Sequential step flow cards with monospace numbered badges (01, 02, 03), active step highlighted state, and SpatialHUDCard floating physics.

props.steps: Array<{ stepNumber: string; title: string; detail: string; active?: boolean }>

components.name: ChecklistCard
components.description: Archetype 5: Checklist card with header status pill badge (green/yellow/red) and tick-mark criteria items wrapped in SpatialHUDCard 3D perspective.

components.name: QuoteCard
components.description: Archetype 6: Statement and quote card featuring an oversized watermark quotation mark, italic statement text, author, role, and source chip inside a SpatialHUDCard 3D frame.
